description: Claude Code from Anthropic's apt repository, found through its deb package name.
why: The deb_packages route's scenario for Claude Code. The .deb installs /usr/bin/claude and nothing under a home directory, so binaries, state_dirs and process_paths all miss it and dpkg's row is the only evidence. must_find alone passes on those routes in other scenarios, so must_contain pins the package row itself. Read off a real apt install on Ubuntu 22.04 on 2026-10-19 (claude-code 2.1.292-1), which a fleet deployed through apt had been reporting every hour while the classifier called each machine clean.
known_gaps: /usr/bin/claude is not a route. binaries is home-rooted, and the package row carries the version, which the binary's path does not, so dpkg's row is the better evidence anyway.

Anthropic's apk repository cannot be exercised, and no route could read it: osquery has no apk_packages table at any version, and osquery's own builds are glibc-linked and do not load on musl, so an Alpine host cannot run the collector at all. Measured 2026-10-20 on alpine:3.22; docs/blind-spots.yaml carries it. 91-linux-claude-rpm carries the dnf repository.
